entities.summary: David Lyndon Emsley FRSC is a British chemist specialising in solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance and a professor at EPFL. He was awarded the 2012 Grand Prix Charles-Leopold Mayer of the French Académie des Sciences and the 2015 Bourke Award of the Royal Society of Chemistry.
